hypothesis: After a SOL five-minute breakout onset has already occurred, a later source evaluation blocked only by awaiting_new_5m_breakout_onset may identify a tradable continuation when side-adjusted visible-book pressure remains aligned. Measure both directions with a 75-minute accepted-entry spacing, adverse recorded BBO entry and exit, observed funding and taker fees, an 80-bps stop proxy, no target, and a fixed 60-minute horizon.
decision: Freeze a report-only prospective observer at 2026-08-08T22:50:00Z. Do not remove the live v25 fresh-onset requirement, do not execute the candidate, and do not pool its outcomes with the older HYPE cooldown or SOL 5m-not-breakout experiments. Hypothesis-formation evidence contains two resolved all-long paths at +45.9418 bps total and +16.3241 bps after removing the largest winner, which is insufficient for promotion but sufficient to measure the exact missed-continuation class prospectively. Future results must retain both-side attribution, concentration, adverse BBO capacity, fees, funding, and the frozen entry-spacing clock.
falsifier: Reject or materially revise the observer if post-cutoff after-cost return is nonpositive excluding the largest winner, if independent episodes do not recur, if the result depends on only one side, if short outcomes are adverse, if visible-book capacity fails, or if source/profile/cutoff identity drifts. Evidence would strengthen only through independent both-side post-cutoff paths with positive after-cost economics excluding the largest winner; no observation grants live authority automatically.
limitations: Hypothesis formation uses only two resolved all-long paths from one live market window.
The observer changes one source blocker and therefore measures a continuation class rather than the deployed fresh-onset contract.
Recorded BBO feasibility is not authenticated private queue position or a counterfactual venue fill.
The fixed 60-minute horizon isolates entry quality and is not an adaptive production exit policy.
The candidate is report-only and cannot enter, close, resize, gate, rank, pause, or promote a live strategy.
